title: Krishna Vrindha Vihari
desc: A man from an orthodox family falls in love and concocts a deception to win his parents' approval for his beloved.

title: Prince
desc: A thief sets out for the ultimate heist but wakes up one day with no memory-putting his life in danger and turning his plan into chaos.

title: Panchamugi
desc: When Goddess Durga's prophecy about Vaishnavi's death comes true, her daughter is left shattered. Meanwhile, Vaishnavi's husband, Rajesh, is stunned when he finds his wife's lookalike in the city.

title: Disco
desc: Disco, orphan cherishing friendship, loves Shiny, don's daughter. Don kidnaps friends, demanding choice between love and loyalty.

title: Ngk
desc: Nandha Gopalan Kumaran, a social worker, is forced to join politics to help his village. He faces various obstacles while learning the tricks to survive in power.

title: Thiruppumunai
desc: Catherine and Aishwarya, co-passengers on a plane journey, become friends and share their love stories. Catherine is shocked when she learns that the man she is dating resembles Aishwarya's fiance.

title: Ready
desc: A man and his family concoct a grand scheme to win over the hearts of a woman and her greedy conniving uncles.

title: Asura Vamsam
desc: An aspiring police officer refuses to give up on his dream despite rejection and clashes with Rahul, the troublesome son of an honest cop.

title: Kalyana Vaibhogam - Srinivasa Kalayanam
desc: An innocent girl marries into a wealthy but cursed family, initially happy. However, her life takes a dark turn when an evil lookalike replaces her to carry out sinister plans.

title: Tamizhukku En Ondrai Azhuthavum
desc: When a solar flare disrupts the mobile connections in a city, Vasanth, an intelligent person, tries to restore them. But he is unaware that a bomb will be activated if he completes the task.

title: Kanne Kalaimaane
desc: Kamalakannan, an organic farmer, marries Bharathi, a bank manager. However, Kamalakannan's grandmother does not want Bharathi to work after marriage, which leads to a tussle between them.

title: A.R.M
desc: Ajayan grapples with his ancestors' complex choices, unearthed through the 'Chiyothivilakku' legacy. Their actions cast long shadows, impacting his present and future.

title: Magadheera
desc: In 400 years, a reincarnated warrior, Harsha, reconnects with his past love while facing a dark force that threatens their budding romance. Can they overcome their fate?

title: Nee Naan Naam
desc: Circumstances force Raja Ram and Nazeera to lead separate lives in different countries. Years later, their daughters strive to reunite the estranged couple.

title: Vishwaroopam
desc: Nirupama, an ambitious woman studying in the USA, marries a dance master, Viswanathan. On being suspicious of his behaviour, she hires a detective, who reveals his true identity and past.

title: Avane Srimannarayana
desc: Narayana attempts to solve the mystery behind the treasure that has gone missing. However, Jayaram, a gang leader, places several obstacles in his way.

title: Kick
desc: On a train, Shaina and Himanshu discuss their arranged marriage. They share past relationships, unaware they both involve the enigmatic Devi and his dangerous 'kick.'

title: Ruler
desc: A businesswoman adopts a stranger who once saved her. Despite her care, his dark past resurfaces, threatening their lives.
